name: crucible-monorepo
description: Crucible: a conformance and resilience testing harness for the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/*/dist/*.test.js packages/*/dist/*/*.test.js
scripts.scan:basic: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js scan -- node packages/fixtures/basic-server/dist/index.js
scripts.scan:stateless: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js scan -- node packages/fixtures/stateless-server/dist/index.js
